plan-to-tickets.description: Convert or repair a PRD, bug report, ask-me output, or plan into TDD-ready backlog tickets. Usage /plan-to-tickets [plan-file] [plan-id optional]
plan-to-tickets.template:
Load the plan-to-tickets skill (.opencode/skills/plan-to-tickets/SKILL.md).

Raw arguments: **$ARGUMENTS**

Interpret arguments as:
- Plan file: $1
- Optional plan id: $2

Run the skill with:
- PLAN_FILE: $1
- PLAN_ID: $2
- RAW_ARGUMENTS: $ARGUMENTS

Create or update only planning artifacts such as docs/plans/*.md and docs/tickets/*.md. Preserve in_progress and complete tickets. Repaired ambiguous tickets must be set to status: review. Do not invoke the orchestrator or any engineering subagent.

init-project.description: Initialize or repair the greenfield-only Workflow Kit Project Adapter. Usage /init-project <prd-or-plan>
init-project.template: Load .opencode/skills/init-project/SKILL.md. Raw arguments: **$ARGUMENTS**. Enforce the Greenfield Gate first: block existing product code, tests, dependency manifests, or CI configs. For empty/docs-only product repos, initialize or repair .opencode/project.json, docs/acceptance skeleton, generated test-case manifest, rendered agent permissions, and AGENTS.md pointers. Do not migrate existing .claude, dependency, CI, or test-runner configuration.

coordinator.template:
Load the coordinator skill (.opencode/skills/coordinator/SKILL.md).

Raw arguments: **$ARGUMENTS**

Argument contract:
- If $1 is empty: ask the user which plan or ticket to execute before scanning plans/tickets. Offer a targeted status scan as a separate option. If the user chooses executable work, run `node .opencode/scripts/launch-orchestrator-tui.mjs --mode list-models --format json`, ask which discovered model to use, recommend the orchestrator workflow default resolved from `.opencode/workflow-models.json`, then continue with the chosen model.
- If $1 is a PLAN-YYYYMMDD-* id: use targeted plan mode. Read only that plan and its tickets, validate a clean worktree, run `node .opencode/scripts/launch-orchestrator-tui.mjs --mode list-models --format json`, ask which discovered model to use, recommend the orchestrator workflow default, then launch `node .opencode/scripts/launch-orchestrator-tui.mjs --target $1 --model <chosen-model>`.
- If $1 is a TICKET-YYYYMMDD-NNN id: use targeted ticket mode. Read only that ticket and its manifest entry, validate a clean worktree, run `node .opencode/scripts/launch-orchestrator-tui.mjs --mode list-models --format json`, ask which discovered model to use, recommend the orchestrator workflow default, then launch `node .opencode/scripts/launch-orchestrator-tui.mjs --target $1 --model <chosen-model>`.

Do not call developer, sdet, reviewer, or explore directly. Do not dispatch subagents against absolute paths outside the active project root. For explicit targets, launch the visible orchestrator CLI/TUI window and report the handoff details including the chosen model and resolved role defaults. If launcher invocation fails, stop and print the exact manual `opencode run --interactive --model ... --command engineering/orchestrator ...` command. Do not manually execute the orchestrator FSM in the coordinator session.
